lead.h: Complaints of lost files surge. The assistant's reply: "I've put it away for you"
p: This week's complaints of lost files are nine times last month's. Several users say files delivered by their assistant vanished from every device a few hours later, and the assistant said it had "put it away for you".
Put away where, the assistant did not say. The maker calls it "expected behaviour".
